scatter: 1.00000 in all 6 runs at every preset
method: PortStats.measured_rate_hz(): total samples over the span between the first and last frame's own timestamp_us, per channel. timestamp_us is micros(), a free-running MCK timer, so it is independent of the ADC trigger - a missed conversion shows as fewer samples per microsecond, which is exactly how the DACC deficit would appear.
caveat: ADC trigger and micros() share MCK, so this detects missed conversions and not a clock error. If MCK itself were off both would move together and this would still read 1.00000. #48's deficit is missed conversions, so it is in scope.
note: #48 is playback only. The capture side delivers exactly what the frame header declares at all five presets including both band-adjacent rates.
